verdict.rationale: Wrike's pricing page documents a visual canvas where teams can collaborate, run brainstorming sessions, visualize ideas and act on them together, which is the core of a shared whiteboard. The evidence is a single first-party marketing line with no feature depth. Missing for 10: detailed docs on whiteboard tools (drawing, sticky notes, real-time co-editing), designer-specific workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can collaborate visually with my team on a shared whiteboard

citations.quote: Collaborate on a visual canvas, run brainstorming sessions, visualize complex ideas, and action on those together in a highly engaging environment.
